option.name: --crypt-method
tip: Use the specified method to encrypt the passwords.
Possible values: NONE, DES, MD5, SHA256, SHA512, YESCRYPT

option.name: --encrypted
tip: Supplied passwords are in encrypted form.

option.name: --md5
tip: Use MD5 encryption instead of DES when the supplied passwords are not encrypted.

option.name: --prefix
tip: Apply changes to configuration files under the root filesystem found under PREFIX_DIR.
This option does not chroot and is intended for preparing a cross-compilation target.

option.name: --root
tip: Apply changes in the CHROOT_DIR directory and use the configuration files from the CHROOT_DIR directory.

option.name: --sha-rounds
tip: Use the specified number of rounds to encrypt the passwords.
Can only be used with the SHA256, SHA512 or YESCRYPT crypt methods.
